mapper.select: SELECT count(*)::integer AS tables,count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.relkind='r')::integer AS regular_tables FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('advertiser_catalog_schema_history','catalog_shard_control', 'catalog_advertiser_guard','catalog_identity','catalog_aggregate','catalog_command','catalog_step','catalog_outbox','catalog_task_item')

SELECT c.shard_id,c.mode, (c.source_id IS NULL AND c.topology_version IS NULL AND c.cluster_id IS NULL AND c.topic_id IS NULL AND c.topic_name IS NULL AND c.initializing_command_id IS NULL AND c.initialization_ready IS FALSE AND c.stop_reason IS NULL AND COALESCE(c.writer_manifest='{}'::jsonb,false)) AS unbound,h.script_sha256, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.advertiser_catalog_schema_history WHERE version=1) AS history_rows FROM public.catalog_shard_control c LEFT JOIN public.advertiser_catalog_schema_history h ON h.shard_id=c.shard_id AND h.version=1

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE application_name=#{self})::integer AS own_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE application_name=#{peer})::integer AS peer_count, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND application_name IN (#{self},#{peer})
